title: 応用バイオ専門実験・演習A
subtitle: Applied Bioscience Major Lab/Exercises A
keywords: Planning, practice, presentation 2.Scientific observation 3.Testing a hypothesis 4.Scientific reports
educationalGoal: Student will: acquire scientific insight through basic lectures and exercises; learn how to write scientific reports; learn the logical considerations for methods, results, and discussion; and learn presentation techniques. The goal of this course is to introduce life science students to the skills of observation and enquiry.
advice: Student will work under the following three themes to acquire information and learn experimental techniques for "sensory function", "behavioral principles" and "bicrobiological production technology". (1) Nerve cell morphology: from microscopic observation to quantitative evaluation (2) Microbiological production with fermentation and microbial transformation
requiredKnowledge: (1) Expertise acquired via related lectures (2) Reading of distributed text materials

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
